body:
I’m honored to have my painting “Harvest” included as the cover of Ill Anthology’s third edition themed Cosecha, published by Curious Publishing. The poetry anthology explores themes of gratitude, growth and gathering. Ill Anthology is a carefully curated collection of poems, artwork and photography, honoring the lasting contributions of Ignacio Lopez. This anthology brings together voices that reflect his legacy in art, culture, and activism, offering a diverse range of poetic expressions that honor his profound impact on the community. You can order a copy through Curious Publishing at:

[ILL Poetry Anthology — Curious Publishing](https://www.curiouspublishing.org/ill-poetry-anthology)
title: Ill Poetry and Art Anthology
